messages:
alex: hey team — our rerank calls started failing this morning after a deploy. getting a 400 with "model_deprecated" in the body. happens for model id `rnk-small-v0`. can you confirm if that model was removed?

maya: sorry you hit this, alex. can you paste the request body (redact PII) and the exact error response body? also how many candidates are you sending per request?

alex: here you go (redacted):
```json
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "model": "rnk-small-v0",
  "query": "best onboarding flow",
  "candidates": ["doc1", "doc2", "doc3"]
}
```
response:
```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "model_deprecated",
    "message": "Model 'rnk-small-v0' is deprecated and no longer available. See model catalog for replacements.",
    "code": 400
  }
}
```

maya: thanks. quick checks: 1) confirm the model id exactly matches what you intended (typo?), 2) confirm you didn't pass an alias that maps to a removed model, 3) did you pin any rollout in the console?

alex: no aliases that I know of, we were using `rnk-small-v0` for months. no rollout pins. the rest of our API calls (text gen) are fine. this only affects the rerank endpoint.

maya: copying eng-runtime for model ownership — @sam can you confirm if `rnk-small-v0` was deprecated? if so, do we have a migration path/alias mapping?

sam: digging in — we flagged `rnk-small-v0` as deprecated last quarter due to quality regressed after tokenizer changes. it should still have a grace period but looks like it expired this week. 2 quick notes:
- customers on hosted API should receive a deprecation warning in account emails and a console banner; maybe the banner was missed.
- we do have recommended replacement: `rnr-sim-v2` (same input schema, improved scoring range).

alex: ugh okay — what's involved to switch? are there any breaking input/output differences I should watch for? we rely on score range for downstream logic.

jordan: quick pointer from devex — `rnr-sim-v2` returns normalized scores in [0,1] and is calibrated differently from very-old `rnk-small-v0` which sometimes returned unbounded logits if you used incompatible request flags. if you currently expect raw logits, set `score_mode: "logit"` in the request for v2; otherwise default gives probabilities. also candidate limits are still 2..100.

sam: confirm — the root cause for the 400 is the model id. two remediation options:
1) update your requests to use `model: "rnr-sim-v2"` and test on a staging key. this is the recommended path.
2) we can temporarily re-enable a compatibility alias `rnk-small-v0 -> rnr-sim-v2` for your org while you migrate, but that requires an internal ticket and audit signoff.

maya: alex, do you want us to enable the alias for you for a short window? we can also create a dedicated ticket with migration steps and sample payloads.

alex: yes please enable alias for 48 hours — need time to push a config change. also can you add a regression test suggestion? we want to avoid surprises next time.

maya: acknowledged. creating escalation ticket now. RINF-1324. I'll request alias for 48h and add a migration checklist.

incident-bot: escalation created RINF-1324 assigned to eng-runtime. Priority: P2. Target response SLA: 4h.

sam: alias request noted. I'll approve the alias but want to add telemetry so we can alert earlier on deprecation windows. will add a flag on the deprecation pipeline to fire an account-level alert 7 days before expiry.

jordan: for the regression test: recommend adding an integration test that calls rerank with a small fixed candidate set (3-5 items) and asserts scoring monotonicity + score range. sample test snippet:```python
resp = client.rerank(model="rnr-sim-v2", query="q", candidates=["A","B","C"])
scores = resp["scores"]
assert all(0.0 <= s <= 1.0 for s in scores)
assert sorted(range(len(scores)), key=lambda i: scores[i]) != list(range(len(scores)))  # not all equal
```

alex: great, will add that. thank you. can you also confirm there won't be billing impact from this failure?

maya: no billing impact for 400 errors from deprecated models. you weren't charged for failed rerank calls. only successful inference calls are billed.

sam: alias applied for org `redwood-corp` for 48h. confirming in console now — you should be able to retry with no code change for the next 48h. I'll follow up in RINF-1324 with the deprecation timeline and the change we made.

alex: retried and it's working. thanks all. leaving a note to add a console opt-in for auto-mapping deprecated rerank models in future. :thumbsup:

maya: closing loop here — marking thread resolved but keeping RINF-1324 open until alias expires and alex confirms migration. feel free to re-open if anything else shows up. :white_check_mark:
